messages:
emma.l: Quick sync — we need final ownership + blocker list for the model-registry launch tomorrow. TL;DR: three new open models (atlas-7b, ripple2-13b, pebble-2.1b), licensing checks mostly done but one outstanding legal question for ripple2.

oliver.k: I'm +1 to ship atlas-7b and pebble-2.1b. ripple2 needs a license clarification (CLA vs permissive). I pinged legal (ticket LEG-3342) but haven't heard back.

ben.c: perf profiles: atlas-7b perf looks good on p3-standard tests (median token latency 18ms @ batch=1). pebble-2.1b needs quantization tweak (int8 causing 3% regression on long-form QA). PR with quantization params: https://git.internal/rw/quant/PR-412 — reviewers?

emma.l: @ben.c can you paste the perf snippet here? we need a quick go/no-go number.

ben.c: sure — snippet:```json
{"model":"pebble-2.1b","seq_len":1024,"batch":1,"median_token_ms":22.4,"regression_vs_fp16":"3%","throughput_tokens_s":4500}```

sara.p: For ownership: I can take catalog metadata + docs for pebble. @oliver.k you own the rollout canary for atlas, @ben.c you own perf gating for pebble, and legal + infra need to clear ripple2. Is that correct?

oliver.k: yep, canary for atlas. Plan: 100 reqs/sec canary in us-west, 2% sample traffic for 6h. If error >1.5% or p90 > 120ms we abort. I'll post the canary config in #eng-infra in a min.

infra-bot: deploy-plan created: DP-8891 (atlas-7b canary) — watcher list: @oliver.k, @sara.p, @oncall. Shifts: 06:00-12:00 UTC.

emma.l: Legal note: LEG-3342 (ripple2 license) — legal asked if ripple2 has a commercial use restriction in the source's LICENSE file. If yes, we cannot host in Hosted API. @oliver.k do we have a fallback (bring-your-own-model or dedicated-only) ready?

oliver.k: We have a dedicated-only fallback pattern implemented — config key: "deployment.allowed_tiers": ["dedicated","private"]. If legal says restricted, we'll mark ripple2 as dedicated/private and set model catalog visibility to internal.

ben.c: Can we get a perf-run for ripple2 on an iso node (to avoid noisy neighbors)? If legal ok then infra can run after sign-off. pinging infra in #eng-infra.

sara.p: Action list (quick):
- @oliver.k: post canary config + own atlas canary (inflight) — due: +6h
- @ben.c: merge quant PR or provide mitigations for pebble perf regression — due: +4h
- @emma.l: follow up w/ legal on LEG-3342 and confirm ripple2 license clause — due: +3h
- infra: schedule iso perf run for ripple2 if cleared — TBD after legal

emma.l: Also small UX ask — tag each model in the catalog with "deployment_restrictions" label when legal restricts access. That makes it easy for console filters.

oliver.k: agreed. I'll add the label to the schema: `labels.deployment_restrictions` (enum).

ben.c: one more thing — test prompts for pebble long-form QA are in: https://internal/bench/prompt-sets/pebble-longform. Please don't change them before the perf retest.

emma.l: Good. If legal clears ripple2 before EOD we can include it in the soft launch. Otherwise we proceed with atlas + pebble. :thumbsup:

sara.p: I'll update the launch checklist and notify PMs. Thanks all.

oliver.k: tagging @infra-oncall for visibility.

infra-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance in us-west ending in ~2h — could affect canary start time. See: https://status.internal/maintenance/345

emma.l: thanks infra-bot — moving the canary window +2h if maintenance holds.

ben.c: I'll queue the quant PR for review now.

sara.p: closing loop: please drop short status updates here as you complete items so I can mark the checklist.

emma.l: update: LEG-3342 -> legal replied: "no commercial restriction, attribution required in README". tagging @ben.c @oliver.k.

oliver.k: awesome — ripple2 can be hosted. I'll add it to the canary roster and schedule perf run.

ben.c: merging quant PR now, running quick perf. will drop numbers in ~20m.

sara.p: thanks everyone — will reconvene async if anything else pops up. :rocket:
